convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators with standard params. Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed or risk-percentage position sizing with optional loss-based reduction. Trade.mqh used only for order execution helpers (CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CDealInfo, CPositionInfo), no custom indicator or complex library logic.

derived_values.name: f1 - Fast MA previous bar value (bar[1])
f0 - Fast MA current bar value (bar[0])
m1 - Middle MA previous bar value (bar[1])
m0 - Middle MA current bar value (bar[0])
s1 - Slow MA previous bar value (bar[1])
s0 - Slow MA current bar value (bar[0])

other_exits: Trailing stop moves SL to breakeven once price moves TrailingStop pips in favor; respects broker StopsLevel minimum distance

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots>0, use fixed lot size. If Lots==0, calculate from FreeMargin*MaximumRisk/1000. If DecreaseFactor>0 and consecutive losses>1, reduce lot by lot*losses/DecreaseFactor. All results normalized to symbol volume constraints.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses previous bar [1] vs current bar [0] indicator values for crossover detection. Buy signal: f1<m1 (fast was below middle on prev bar) AND m0>f0 (middle above fast on current bar = fast crossed above middle) AND m1<s1 (middle below slow on prev bar) AND f0<s0 (fast below slow on current bar). The crossover condition is encoded as f1<m1 && m0<f0 for buy (fast crosses up through middle) and f1>m1 && m0>f0 for sell (fast crosses down through middle), with both MAs required to remain below/above the slow MA respectively. Trailing stop only activates when new SL would be at or better than entry price (breakeven guard). Trailing respects broker StopsLevel. Deviation is set dynamically at 3x current spread per trade.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward 3-SMA crossover system. All three MAs are simple SMA on CLOSE with shifts. Entry signals use bar[1] vs bar[0] comparison for crossover detection. SL/TP are fixed pip values from entry price. Position sizing has two modes: fixed lot or risk-based (FreeMargin*risk/1000). Loss-based lot reduction iterates deal history backward counting consecutive losses. Trailing stop is standard: move SL to bid-TrailStop for longs (ask+TrailStop for shorts) only when it improves position. No digit adjustment needed - uses _Point directly which is already broker-adjusted. CTrade/CSymbolInfo/CPositionInfo wrappers map to standard broker API calls.
